page.overview:
Who is Xavier Dobbs?

Xavier Dobbs is a character in Jurassic World: Rebirth. He is the boyfriend to Teresa Delgado.

Wanting to have one last family adventure before Teresa left for college, her father Reuben Delgado took his two daughters, Teresa and Isabella, sailing in the Atlantic Ocean on his boat, La Mariposa. They also brought along her boyfriend, Xavier Dobbs, to which Reuben reluctantly agreed to.

As the Delgados' sailboat neared Ile Saint-Hubert, they were capsized by a Mosasaurus as it perceived their boat to be a competitor in its territory. Reuben, Teresa, Isabella, and Xavier survived the incident and managed to retrieve the radio in which Reuben spent the night calling for help. The following day, they were discovered by The Essex. The crew aboard were mercenaries led by Duncan Kincaid and Zora Bennett, assisted by paleontologist Dr. Henry Loomis. They were employed by Martin Krebs, a representative for Parker-Genix Pharmaceutical Engineering. They were bound for Ile Saint-Hubert to obtain living tissue samples from three of the largest cloned dinosaurs on the island so their material could be used to develop a cure for heart disease. This was considered an illegal operation that Krebs wanted kept secret, and assured Reuben that he and his family would be dropped off at the village on the island as it's powered by geothermal energy.

The Mosasaurus was among the dinosaurs they were targeting, and Bennett was able to obtain a sample. However, as they approached the island, the Mosasaurus, along with a pack of Spinosaurs, attacked the ship. Reuben had Teresa go to the radio and call for help. Desperate to keep the mission a secret, Krebs followed Teresa and kept her from radioing for help. As the boat was struck, Teresa fell overboard due to Krebs intentionally letting her fall. Xavier went in the waters after her, followed by Reuben and Isabella. The family reunited, and Teresa revealed to Reuben that Krebs kept her from radioing for help and let her fall overboard. While the remaining Essex crew continued with their mission, Reuben led his family to the InGen village complex by following the geothermal pipes.
